description: Milestone crowdfunding for AI agent projects on devnet: three Anchor 0.30.1 programs for an agent/project registry, a SOL or token escrow released milestone by milestone through contribution-weighted backer votes with refunds if the goal is missed, and an authority-run reputation score. All three programs verified with real transactions.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration of agentIgris/AgentFund. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/AgentFund. The lab only changed declare_id to a unique Sol.College devnet program. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness (milestone escrow, votes, refunds, registry, reputation)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/agentfund/
QA: devnet proof of vote-gated milestone release
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Exercise an SPL-token campaign on devnet
